definition: a sentimental longing or wistful affection for the past
hook: Nostalgia feels warm. Its Greek roots describe a wound.
modernAnchor: An old song comes on. You are somewhere else entirely, somewhere that no longer exists.
journey: A Swiss physician coined the word in 1688 to name a condition he saw in soldiers far from home.
Nostos means return. Algos means pain. Together they described something doctors treated as a disease.
Physicians believed extreme homesickness could be fatal. Soldiers were sometimes sent back as a cure.
What we now call a warm feeling was once diagnosed as a dangerous and potentially lethal disorder.
